verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own marketing says busywork can be "described once, done automatically," its custom categorization rules point to user-defined automation, and AI Close uses agents to reconcile and review transactions. However, nothing documents recurring schedules, triggers, or truly unattended background runs, and outputs are reviewed by the user before anything is final. missing for 10: documented scheduling or trigger configuration for recurring automations, evidence that automations run unattended in the background, details on how custom rules execute, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final.
AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
